## Run 45 QA report — delivered

**Report written & committed** — `OVERNIGHT-REPORT.md` (commit `c79eb1d`), regenerated for Run 45 with all required sections: QA Summary, Backend API, Frontend, UI Audit, Bugs Fixed, Known Issues, Coverage Gaps, Session Integrity.

**History appended** — `docs/overnight-history.md` got a new `## QA Run: 2026-06-13 (Run 45)` block (appended, not overwritten — file is now 2418 lines).

**Resume updated** — `overnight_resume.md` got an s5 closeout section, including the happy-path write-probe result I captured live (server was up, rate-limit window cleared).

**Final build** — `npx vite build` PASS, 7.85s, only the pre-existing chunk-size warnings.

### What the run found
A **convergence run**: 0 bugs, 0 fixes. 453 API probes (387 standing + 63 new GET sweep + 3 happy-path writes) → **0 unintentional 5xx** (24th consecutive clean sweep). Frontend render + mobile + empty-state all verified clean by s4. The single commit (`60ba290`) added read-only probe coverage, not a fix. s2 (frontend walk) and s3 (UI audit) both hit max-turns and made no changes — captured honestly in the report as coverage gaps.

### Email — staged, not sent
The Gmail integration only exposes `create_draft` (no send tool), so I **couldn't dispatch it autonomously**. I created a draft to **brandon@accessvaletparking.com** with the full summary — subject *"StormLeads Overnight QA Report — 2026-06-13 (Run 45): converged, 0 bugs, 0 fixes."* It's in your Drafts ready for one-click review/send.

Highest-value untouched targets for the next run, per the report: tablet 768px sweep (stalest gap), the remaining frontend page walk, and a11y/keyboard-nav (never attempted).
